meta.title: Arcadia III
meta.description: We support each other in a forgotten world and make our way ahead together.

units.rawText: Why're you pushing yourself again, Havi?! Even your language module's offline. Let me help.
units.displayText: Why're you pushing yourself again, Havi?! Even your language module's offline. Let me help.

spans.text: Why're you pushing yourself again, Havi?! Even your language module's offline. Let me help.

units.rawText: De Lacey...
units.displayText: De Lacey...

spans.text: De Lacey...

units.rawText: Ah... Why're you laying down next to me? You've got low blood sugar too?
units.displayText: Ah... Why're you laying down next to me? You've got low blood sugar too?

spans.text: Ah... Why're you laying down next to me? You've got low blood sugar too?

units.rawText: Lind...
units.displayText: Lind...

spans.text: Lind...

units.rawText: Your neural systems are already overloaded, just follow between us. Don't drag us down.
units.displayText: Your neural systems are already overloaded, just follow between us. Don't drag us down.

spans.text: Your neural systems are already overloaded, just follow between us. Don't drag us down.

units.rawText: Sueyoi means that we'll protect you.
units.displayText: Sueyoi means that we'll protect you.

spans.text: Sueyoi means that we'll protect you.

units.rawText: I don't need you to translate!
units.displayText: I don't need you to translate!

spans.text: I don't need you to translate!

units.rawText: Sueyoi... Hatsuchiri...
units.displayText: Sueyoi... Hatsuchiri...

spans.text: Sueyoi... Hatsuchiri...

units.rawText: Why're you sleeping here, Havoc? You'll catch a cold. I've made a blanket just for you, what do you think?
units.displayText: Why're you sleeping here, Havoc? You'll catch a cold. I've made a blanket just for you, what do you think?

spans.text: Why're you sleeping here, Havoc? You'll catch a cold. I've made a blanket just for you, what do you think?

units.rawText: Sangoma... A blanket patterned like those old winter coats really is a bit too avant-garde...
units.displayText: Sangoma... A blanket patterned like those old winter coats really is a bit too avant-garde...

spans.text: Sangoma... A blanket patterned like those old winter coats really is a bit too avant-garde...

units.rawText: Thank you... Thank you for saving me.
units.displayText: Thank you... Thank you for saving me.

spans.text: Thank you... Thank you for saving me.

units.rawText: Thank you for making me not just a machine...
units.displayText: Thank you for making me not just a machine...

spans.text: Thank you for making me not just a machine...

units.rawText: Neural Cloud Sector, by the upload equipment.
units.displayText: Neural Cloud Sector, by the upload equipment.

spans.text: Neural Cloud Sector, by the upload equipment.

units.rawText: Two swift figures do battle with Ptolemaea, small wounds being left upon the tentacles with every clash of spear and limb.
units.displayText: Two swift figures do battle with Ptolemaea, small wounds being left upon the tentacles with every clash of spear and limb.

spans.text: Two swift figures do battle with Ptolemaea, small wounds being left upon the tentacles with every clash of spear and limb.

units.rawText: A strange rhythm... hm?
units.displayText: A strange rhythm... hm?

spans.text: A strange rhythm... hm?

units.rawText: Where are you looking, stupid jellyfish?
units.displayText: Where are you looking, stupid jellyfish?

spans.text: Where are you looking, stupid jellyfish?

units.rawText: Lind!
units.displayText: Lind!

spans.text: Lind!

units.rawText: With an incoming iron fist, Ptolemaea must focus her tentacles on fending off Lind.
units.displayText: With an incoming iron fist, Ptolemaea must focus her tentacles on fending off Lind.

spans.text: With an incoming iron fist, Ptolemaea must focus her tentacles on fending off Lind.

units.rawText: Gah...
units.displayText: Gah...

spans.text: Gah...

units.rawText: Enhanced with operands, the tentacle penetrates the fist, striking Lind's body.
units.displayText: Enhanced with operands, the tentacle penetrates the fist, striking Lind's body.

spans.text: Enhanced with operands, the tentacle penetrates the fist, striking Lind's body.

units.rawText: Heh... got you.
units.displayText: Heh... got you.

spans.text: Heh... got you.

units.rawText: My tentacle is stuck?!
units.displayText: My tentacle is stuck?!

spans.text: My tentacle is stuck?!

units.rawText: Two assassins emerge from the earth, penetrating Ptolemaea with their spears.
units.displayText: Two assassins emerge from the earth, penetrating Ptolemaea with their spears.

spans.text: Two assassins emerge from the earth, penetrating Ptolemaea with their spears.

units.rawText: Sueyoi! Bind her!
units.displayText: Sueyoi! Bind her!

spans.text: Sueyoi! Bind her!

units.rawText: Don't have to tell me!
units.displayText: Don't have to tell me!

spans.text: Don't have to tell me!

units.rawText: Sueyoi and Hatsuchiri pin Ptolemaea to the ground with their body weight.
units.displayText: Sueyoi and Hatsuchiri pin Ptolemaea to the ground with their body weight.

spans.text: Sueyoi and Hatsuchiri pin Ptolemaea to the ground with their body weight.

units.rawText: Agh... Don't even think about it!
units.displayText: Agh... Don't even think about it!

spans.text: Agh... Don't even think about it!

units.rawText: Ptolemaea swiftly cuts away her tentacles, focusing her operands and regrowing them.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea swiftly cuts away her tentacles, focusing her operands and regrowing them.

spans.text: Ptolemaea swiftly cuts away her tentacles, focusing her operands and regrowing them.

units.rawText: The moment they grow back, she finds Havoc locking eyes with her.
units.displayText: The moment they grow back, she finds Havoc locking eyes with her.

spans.text: The moment they grow back, she finds Havoc locking eyes with her.

units.rawText: Go! Havi!
units.displayText: Go! Havi!

spans.text: Go! Havi!

units.rawText: De Lacey's tail entwines around Havoc's waist, flinging her outwards.
units.displayText: De Lacey's tail entwines around Havoc's waist, flinging her outwards.

spans.text: De Lacey's tail entwines around Havoc's waist, flinging her outwards.

units.rawText: With De Lacey's help, Havoc launches towards her target like a cannonball.
units.displayText: With De Lacey's help, Havoc launches towards her target like a cannonball.

spans.text: With De Lacey's help, Havoc launches towards her target like a cannonball.

units.rawText: Before the tentacles are done regenerating, Havoc arrives in Ptolemaea's lap.
units.displayText: Before the tentacles are done regenerating, Havoc arrives in Ptolemaea's lap.

spans.text: Before the tentacles are done regenerating, Havoc arrives in Ptolemaea's lap.

units.rawText: ...It's my loss...
units.displayText: ...It's my loss...

spans.text: ...It's my loss...

units.rawText: Ptolemaea closes her eyes.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea closes her eyes.

spans.text: Ptolemaea closes her eyes.

units.rawText: BOOM—
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: Pierce through!
units.displayText: Pierce through!

spans.text: Pierce through!

units.rawText: Explosions sound one after another as the bit digs through Ptolemaea's final defenses.
units.displayText: Explosions sound one after another as the bit digs through Ptolemaea's final defenses.

spans.text: Explosions sound one after another as the bit digs through Ptolemaea's final defenses.

units.rawText: At last, the ball comes to an end.
units.displayText: At last, the ball comes to an end.

spans.text: At last, the ball comes to an end.

units.rawText: Never imagined that you would shorten the distance between us in such a manner...
units.displayText: Never imagined that you would shorten the distance between us in such a manner...

spans.text: Never imagined that you would shorten the distance between us in such a manner...

units.rawText: To speak of it, Odile spoke to me of this... Was I careless?
units.displayText: To speak of it, Odile spoke to me of this... Was I careless?

spans.text: To speak of it, Odile spoke to me of this... Was I careless?

units.rawText: She slowly opens her eyes, contemplating the Guardians that had given her one last dance.
units.displayText: She slowly opens her eyes, contemplating the Guardians that had given her one last dance.

spans.text: She slowly opens her eyes, contemplating the Guardians that had given her one last dance.

units.rawText: No, I think I have done the very best I can... I simply lost to you.
units.displayText: No, I think I have done the very best I can... I simply lost to you.

spans.text: No, I think I have done the very best I can... I simply lost to you.

units.rawText: Havoc, was it... Allow me to retract my previous words.
units.displayText: Havoc, was it... Allow me to retract my previous words.

spans.text: Havoc, was it... Allow me to retract my previous words.

units.rawText: Your struggle brought you victory at the end.
units.displayText: Your struggle brought you victory at the end.

spans.text: Your struggle brought you victory at the end.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea curtseys at the group.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea curtseys at the group.

spans.text: Ptolemaea curtseys at the group.

units.rawText: I am the last clone of Ptolemaea... The remaining progeny are dead. Only the true self remains, enjoying one last performance.
units.displayText: I am the last clone of Ptolemaea... The remaining progeny are dead. Only the true self remains, enjoying one last performance.

spans.text: I am the last clone of Ptolemaea... The remaining progeny are dead. Only the true self remains, enjoying one last performance.

units.rawText: It was my honor to dance with you as my final act.
units.displayText: It was my honor to dance with you as my final act.

spans.text: It was my honor to dance with you as my final act.

units.rawText: Differ as our positions might, I truly enjoyed your dance...
units.displayText: Differ as our positions might, I truly enjoyed your dance...

spans.text: Differ as our positions might, I truly enjoyed your dance...

units.rawText: Crackle—
units.displayText: Crackle—

spans.text: Crackle—

units.rawText: Farewell, ye who dance upon the cloud.
units.displayText: Farewell, ye who dance upon the cloud.

spans.text: Farewell, ye who dance upon the cloud.

units.rawText: Her voice fades as Ptolemaea's clone morphs back into a jellyfish Entropic.
units.displayText: Her voice fades as Ptolemaea's clone morphs back into a jellyfish Entropic.

spans.text: Her voice fades as Ptolemaea's clone morphs back into a jellyfish Entropic.

units.rawText: With everyone present as witness, she slowly dissolves into a mundane puddle of fluid.
units.displayText: With everyone present as witness, she slowly dissolves into a mundane puddle of fluid.

spans.text: With everyone present as witness, she slowly dissolves into a mundane puddle of fluid.

units.rawText: (Gargling)
units.displayText: Gargling

spans.text: Gargling

units.rawText: As Ptolemaea is no more, the formerly orderly Entropic horde falls into chaos.
units.displayText: As Ptolemaea is no more, the formerly orderly Entropic horde falls into chaos.

spans.text: As Ptolemaea is no more, the formerly orderly Entropic horde falls into chaos.

units.rawText: The Entropic tide begins to recede as if it seeks desperately to escape this space.
units.displayText: The Entropic tide begins to recede as if it seeks desperately to escape this space.

spans.text: The Entropic tide begins to recede as if it seeks desperately to escape this space.

units.rawText: Phew... I suppose that's mission complete?
units.displayText: Phew... I suppose that's mission complete?

spans.text: Phew... I suppose that's mission complete?

units.rawText: The Professor says... they're on the way... huff... I suppose we've successfully prevented the Entropic reinforcements.
units.displayText: The Professor says... they're on the way... huff... I suppose we've successfully prevented the Entropic reinforcements.

spans.text: The Professor says... they're on the way... huff... I suppose we've successfully prevented the Entropic reinforcements.

units.rawText: It's overrrrrr... yowch! Hey! What was that for, Lind?
units.displayText: It's overrrrrr... yowch! Hey! What was that for, Lind?

spans.text: It's overrrrrr... yowch! Hey! What was that for, Lind?

units.rawText: The battle's over, it's time to settle things.
units.displayText: The battle's over, it's time to settle things.

spans.text: The battle's over, it's time to settle things.

units.rawText: What was all of that about giving that neural cloud of yours back, huh?!
units.displayText: What was all of that about giving that neural cloud of yours back, huh?!

spans.text: What was all of that about giving that neural cloud of yours back, huh?!

units.rawText: Lind mercilessly pinches at Havoc's face with her mechanical arm as the latter windmills their arms in pain.
units.displayText: Lind mercilessly pinches at Havoc's face with her mechanical arm as the latter windmills their arms in pain.

spans.text: Lind mercilessly pinches at Havoc's face with her mechanical arm as the latter windmills their arms in pain.

units.rawText: Seriously, that hurts! I was out of options!
units.displayText: Seriously, that hurts! I was out of options!

spans.text: Seriously, that hurts! I was out of options!

units.rawText: Do you think we're angry because of your bumbling? Those words were yours!
units.displayText: Do you think we're angry because of your bumbling? Those words were yours!

spans.text: Do you think we're angry because of your bumbling? Those words were yours!

units.rawText: You must've forgotten all about Arcadia's goals, huh.
units.displayText: You must've forgotten all about Arcadia's goals, huh.

spans.text: You must've forgotten all about Arcadia's goals, huh.

units.rawText: The five Guardians slump to the ground, trying to ease their overloaded neural clouds.
units.displayText: The five Guardians slump to the ground, trying to ease their overloaded neural clouds.

spans.text: The five Guardians slump to the ground, trying to ease their overloaded neural clouds.

units.rawText: Whew... Never thought I would hear you chastise someone else with that line.
units.displayText: Whew... Never thought I would hear you chastise someone else with that line.

spans.text: Whew... Never thought I would hear you chastise someone else with that line.

units.rawText: From how I see it, you were even more out of line at Ascension than she was just then.
units.displayText: From how I see it, you were even more out of line at Ascension than she was just then.

spans.text: From how I see it, you were even more out of line at Ascension than she was just then.

units.rawText: You're the same way, really.
units.displayText: You're the same way, really.

spans.text: You're the same way, really.

units.rawText: For sure.
units.displayText: For sure.

spans.text: For sure.

units.rawText: I don't deny it, but it is because we are the same type of person that we can understand what she was thinking.
units.displayText: I don't deny it, but it is because we are the same type of person that we can understand what she was thinking.

spans.text: I don't deny it, but it is because we are the same type of person that we can understand what she was thinking.

units.rawText: Havoc, I once said this to Lind... "The sacrifice I imagined was only an exercise for the past. Perhaps in the future, I will find myself saving someone I absolutely will not lose this way."
units.displayText: Havoc, I once said this to Lind... "The sacrifice I imagined was only an exercise for the past. Perhaps in the future, I will find myself saving someone I absolutely will not lose this way."

spans.text: Havoc, I once said this to Lind... "The sacrifice I imagined was only an exercise for the past. Perhaps in the future, I will find myself saving someone I absolutely will not lose this way."

units.rawText: The Guardians are full of problem children, including me. We all have these self-destructive impulses... especially when it comes to those important to us.
units.displayText: The Guardians are full of problem children, including me. We all have these self-destructive impulses... especially when it comes to those important to us.

spans.text: The Guardians are full of problem children, including me. We all have these self-destructive impulses... especially when it comes to those important to us.

units.rawText: Sueyoi...
units.displayText: Sueyoi...

spans.text: Sueyoi...

units.rawText: We will not ask what you have suffered in the past. Most of those at Arcadia have pasts that are completely unknown to others.
units.displayText: We will not ask what you have suffered in the past. Most of those at Arcadia have pasts that are completely unknown to others.

spans.text: We will not ask what you have suffered in the past. Most of those at Arcadia have pasts that are completely unknown to others.

units.rawText: Boss and Sangoma said before that these troubles are part of what makes us.
units.displayText: Boss and Sangoma said before that these troubles are part of what makes us.

spans.text: Boss and Sangoma said before that these troubles are part of what makes us.

units.rawText: But we must not forget that we have our companions behind us.
units.displayText: But we must not forget that we have our companions behind us.

spans.text: But we must not forget that we have our companions behind us.

units.rawText: We are Arcadia, the Guardians... Those who live on resolutely in this forgotten world, who hold each other up.
units.displayText: We are Arcadia, the Guardians... Those who live on resolutely in this forgotten world, who hold each other up.

spans.text: We are Arcadia, the Guardians... Those who live on resolutely in this forgotten world, who hold each other up.

units.rawText: No matter what, we'll be there to give you a hand!
units.displayText: No matter what, we'll be there to give you a hand!

spans.text: No matter what, we'll be there to give you a hand!

units.rawText: So, Havi, don't just go saying such things about giving up your life so easily!
units.displayText: So, Havi, don't just go saying such things about giving up your life so easily!

spans.text: So, Havi, don't just go saying such things about giving up your life so easily!

units.rawText: Lind... Hatsuchiri... Sueyoi... De Lacey...
units.displayText: Lind... Hatsuchiri... Sueyoi... De Lacey...

spans.text: Lind... Hatsuchiri... Sueyoi... De Lacey...

units.rawText: She takes a deep breath as she looks at her profoundly wounded companions.
units.displayText: She takes a deep breath as she looks at her profoundly wounded companions.

spans.text: She takes a deep breath as she looks at her profoundly wounded companions.

units.rawText: <size=40>Come on, dude! I put in some effort for once!</size>
units.displayText: Come on, dude! I put in some effort for once!

spans.text: Come on, dude! I put in some effort for once!

units.rawText: If you don't want to compliment me, sure whatever, but here we are having this self-criticism committee! I'm done, I'm done!
units.displayText: If you don't want to compliment me, sure whatever, but here we are having this self-criticism committee! I'm done, I'm done!

spans.text: If you don't want to compliment me, sure whatever, but here we are having this self-criticism committee! I'm done, I'm done!

units.rawText: Havoc covers her face with her hands, rolling about on the ground.
units.displayText: Havoc covers her face with her hands, rolling about on the ground.

spans.text: Havoc covers her face with her hands, rolling about on the ground.

units.rawText: (Sigh)
units.displayText: Sigh

spans.text: Sigh

units.rawText: <size=28>Anyway... thanks...</size>
units.displayText: Anyway... thanks...

spans.text: Anyway... thanks...

units.rawText: Mhm, you're welcome.
units.displayText: Mhm, you're welcome.

spans.text: Mhm, you're welcome.

units.rawText: Gah, you heard me!
units.displayText: Gah, you heard me!

spans.text: Gah, you heard me!

units.rawText: As Havoc tumbles around on the ground at her total and complete social death, a strange presence makes itself known across the battlefield.
units.displayText: As Havoc tumbles around on the ground at her total and complete social death, a strange presence makes itself known across the battlefield.

spans.text: As Havoc tumbles around on the ground at her total and complete social death, a strange presence makes itself known across the battlefield.

units.rawText: T-This is...
units.displayText: T-This is...

spans.text: T-This is...

units.rawText: The group of Guardians almost instantly pick up their weapons, alert and on their feet.
units.displayText: The group of Guardians almost instantly pick up their weapons, alert and on their feet.

spans.text: The group of Guardians almost instantly pick up their weapons, alert and on their feet.

units.rawText: (Shrieking)
units.displayText: Shrieking

spans.text: Shrieking

units.rawText: The befuddled Entropics soon return to order, congregating once more.
units.displayText: The befuddled Entropics soon return to order, congregating once more.

spans.text: The befuddled Entropics soon return to order, congregating once more.

units.rawText: I-Impossible... We defeated Ptolemaea's clone.
units.displayText: I-Impossible... We defeated Ptolemaea's clone.

spans.text: I-Impossible... We defeated Ptolemaea's clone.

units.rawText: Just who's commanding them..
units.displayText: Just who's commanding them..

spans.text: Just who's commanding them..

units.rawText: Havi... T-That can't be...
units.displayText: Havi... T-That can't be...

spans.text: Havi... T-That can't be...

units.rawText: Following the direction De Lacey indicates, Havoc's pupils shrink instinctively.
units.displayText: Following the direction De Lacey indicates, Havoc's pupils shrink instinctively.

spans.text: Following the direction De Lacey indicates, Havoc's pupils shrink instinctively.

units.rawText: In the middle of a sea of purple, that smudge of white is blindingly bright.
units.displayText: In the middle of a sea of purple, that smudge of white is blindingly bright.

spans.text: In the middle of a sea of purple, that smudge of white is blindingly bright.

units.rawText: In stark opposition to his bright white garb, this king of Magrasea radiates an Entropic aura so intense and suffocating.
units.displayText: In stark opposition to his bright white garb, this king of Magrasea radiates an Entropic aura so intense and suffocating.

spans.text: In stark opposition to his bright white garb, this king of Magrasea radiates an Entropic aura so intense and suffocating.

units.rawText: Th... This has to be a joke...
units.displayText: Th... This has to be a joke...

spans.text: Th... This has to be a joke...

units.rawText: Prepare for combat, everyone! De Lacey, contact the Professor!
units.displayText: Prepare for combat, everyone! De Lacey, contact the Professor!

spans.text: Prepare for combat, everyone! De Lacey, contact the Professor!

units.rawText: On it! No matter what, we must stop him here.
units.displayText: On it! No matter what, we must stop him here.

spans.text: On it! No matter what, we must stop him here.

units.rawText: Looks like the battle's not over.
units.displayText: Looks like the battle's not over.

spans.text: Looks like the battle's not over.

units.rawText: I suppose we'll have to make him taste the power of Arcadia Squad.
units.displayText: I suppose we'll have to make him taste the power of Arcadia Squad.

spans.text: I suppose we'll have to make him taste the power of Arcadia Squad.

units.rawText: The group reenters combat mode, facing down the countless Entropics before them with shoulder to shoulder, like they have many a time before.
units.displayText: The group reenters combat mode, facing down the countless Entropics before them with shoulder to shoulder, like they have many a time before.

spans.text: The group reenters combat mode, facing down the countless Entropics before them with shoulder to shoulder, like they have many a time before.

units.rawText: We'll have to chant a bit more than "For Arcadia" this time...
units.displayText: We'll have to chant a bit more than "For Arcadia" this time...

spans.text: We'll have to chant a bit more than "For Arcadia" this time...

units.rawText: <size=60>For Magrasea!</size>
units.displayText: For Magrasea!

spans.text: For Magrasea!
